graphEvents.label: Top six workflows are 58 percent of a sweep

label: The 21 workflows with recorded runs sum to about 4129 s of mean wall clock per sweep, and the six largest account for 2377 s, or 58 percent.
The ten smallest guards total about 960 s, 23 percent of the sweep, so deleting all of them saves less than one Spec-Kit Check run.
message-contract.yml re-runs the pre-push validator three ways plus its own unit suite, so its 135 s buys only the uninstalled-hook case.
naming-standard-guard.yml installs pytest 8.4.2 at run time for two Python test files and its pip cache key points at the workflow file rather than the tests.
playbook-operator-contract.yml validates the fleet twice, and the second pass is justified because absence would read as a pass; the two can merge into one strict json run for a trivial saving.
CodeQL has no workflow file in the tree, so its 319 s is configured on the repository settings and must be excluded from any time-ranked cut list.
